title: Microsoft Entra: Mandatory multifactor authentication for admin portals — phase 2

details.name: Summary
details.value: Microsoft Entra: Mandatory multifactor authentication for admin portals — phase 2

body.content:
Phase 2 of mandatory MFA extends to Azure CLI, PowerShell and infrastructure-as-code tools.

What you need to do to prepare: Make sure break-glass accounts and automation use workload identities or certificate-based authentication.
